integrity: Public formulas supported by full proof and reproducible independent standard-library checks. No claim of independent verification or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Characterizes sharpness of the bipartition lower bound on arbitrary trees and all equalizer sets when each degree-two vertex has a leaf neighbor; does not compute equidistant dimension for arbitrary trees outside the sharpness class. Finite verifiers support, but do not replace, the universal proof. Historical priority and independent validation remain uncertain.
title: A local sharpness criterion for the tree equidistant bound and a complete reduced-tree spectrum
